messages.author: Sayilpreet Kaur
messages.body:
Dear amber users,
I am working on RNA based simulations, so I was looking for Atom types and forcefield parameters for N1 protonated and deprotonated form of guanosine but could not find in amber library. There are parameters for protonated Adenosine and cytosine in protonated nucleic acid library, but not found the same in case of guanosine. Could anyone help to solve this issue?
Thank you.
